skill_name: Explain the characteristics of generative models
workflow: Generative models are a class of Artificial Intelligence models that are able to generate outputs that match given data or other desired criteria. They can be used for a range of tasks, such as image generation, text generation, speech recognition, and data prediction. Generative models are trained on large collections of data and usually use deep learning techniques to learn patterns in that data.
